recipes.name: Sugar-Free Fudgy Two-Bite Brownies
ingredients: ⅓ cup dairy-free dark chocolate chips
instructions: Line or oil a mini muffin pan. Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
Combine the ground flaxseeds and milk in a large bowl. Set aside.
Add the hazelnuts and dates to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to the large bowl as well, and add all the remaining ingredients. Mix until well combined.
Spoon a tablespoon of batter into each well. Bake on the centre rack for 22 to 25 minutes or until the top is firm and a toothpick comes out clean.
Allow to cool for a couple of minutes before removing from the tin. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Keeps frozen for up to 1 month.
